title: Open Lexical Source Licensing Ledger
description: Ledger of licensing records and provenance for multilingual dictionaries and lexical sources

source_id.description: Unique identifier for the source dataset

url.description: Canonical URL where the source material is distributed

author.description: Attributed author or organization responsible for the source material

version.description: Specific version or release tag of the source material

modification_status.description: How the source material was used or altered

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the downloaded source artifact (optional)

verified_evidence.description: Evidence that the declared license is actually verified in the source artifact
